SHARE YOUR STORY WITH FOLKFRAME Every photograph can show us something. Some photographs have something to tell. At FolkFrame, we are not simply looking for beautiful images. We are looking for stories told through photography.Your story may be about a person, a place, a culture, a relationship, a community, or a part of everyday life.It does not have to be extraordinary.What matters is that there is something worth telling — and a personal point of view behind it.If your photographs carry a story, we would like to discover it WHAT TO SUBMIT We primarily welcome photo series and visual stories — a group of photographs connected by a shared subject, person, place, experience, or idea.Your series does not need to be a large or formal project. It can be a small story from everyday life, aslong as the photographs belong together and help tell something as a whole.For a photo series:Please send 3–10 photographs from the same story or project, along with a short description of what the work is about.If you do not have a complete series but have a particularly strong individual photograph with a meaningful story behind it, you may also submit it for consideration.Please avoid sending a random selection of unrelated photographs.We appreciate every photographer who shares their work with us.While we are unable to feature every submission, each one will be considered carefully as part of our editorial selection. COPYRIGHT,AUTHENTICITY & OPPORTUNITIES By submitting your work,you confirm that the photographs are your own original work and that you are the photographer and copyright holder, or otherwise have the necessary rights to submit them.AI-generated images, or photographs containing substantial AI-generated visual elements, are not accepted. Standard photographic editing and post-processing are permitted.In some cases, FolkFramemay request an original file, such as a RAW or original camera file, to help verify authorship and authenticity.By submitting your work,you give FolkFrame Photography permission to publish selected photographs on its media platforms with proper credit.Copyright always remains with the photographer.Our aim is not only to share meaningful photography, but also to help photographers and their work reach new audiences and opportunities.If your work receives a purchase or acquisition inquiry, or attracts the interest of a gallery,cultural or artistic organization, curator, publisher, or collector, FolkFramewill connect the interested party directly with you.Any decision regarding the sale, licensing, pricing, or further use of your work remains between youand the interested party.By sending your submission, you confirm that you have read and understood these conditions Please also include: • Full name • City & country • A short introduction about yourself • A short description of the story or project • Contact email or Telegram username • Instagram, website, YouTube, or portfolio link, if available Image requirements: • Photographs taken with either a camera or a mobile phone are welcome. • Please send the highest-quality version available, preferably at least 2000 pixels on the longest side. • JPEG is preferred for submission. • Horizontal and vertical photographs are both accepted. • Please send images without watermarks, logos, borders, or added text. Please send your photos via direct message 💌
